opportunities.title: Research Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) before submitting; hold an independent research post; not currently holding another active Research Fund grant; applications limited to one per department with Head of Department support.
opportunities.summary: Supports members with limited access to research funds to start new projects, particularly those in less well-funded institutes, developing countries and early career researchers. Provides up to £5000 for 12 months covering chemicals/equipment, consumables, specialist software licences, equipment repairs and equipment access.

opportunities.title: Researcher Development and Travel Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Partner Scientist, Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC); PhD students actively undertaking a PhD in the chemical sciences, or researchers in the chemical sciences within 10 years of leaving full-time education.
opportunities.summary: Supports PhD students and early career scientists in industry and academia to undertake an activity that supports their research career, such as conference participation, training courses or organising a scientific meeting. Up to £500 per grant.

opportunities.title: Outreach Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants aged 18 and over; UK or Republic of Ireland resident (with UK/ROI address and bank account) or applying on behalf of an organisation registered in the UK/ROI; project must have a significant aspect related to the chemical sciences.
opportunities.summary: Funds chemistry-based public engagement and outreach projects that connect communities from all backgrounds with the chemical sciences, including developing chemists' engagement skills, engaging school students and public audiences, and providing under-represented audiences with chemistry engagement opportunities. Open throughout 2026 with rolling deadlines; final deadline 2 October 2026.

opportunities.title: Grants for Carers
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland, or if based outside these countries must hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; must incur additional caring expenses while attending a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event.
opportunities.summary: Supports carers to attend a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event by covering additional costs incurred for care that they usually provide. Up to £1,200 per year.

opportunities.title: Accessibility Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a chemist; based in the UK or Ireland, or if based outside these countries must hold valid RSC membership for a minimum of three consecutive years; must use funds to cover support/assistance personally required relating to a disability, impairment or health condition to attend a chemistry-related event.
opportunities.summary: Supports disabled chemists and those with ongoing health conditions with the cost of specific support to attend a chemistry-related meeting, conference, workshop or professional development event, such as accessible travel, personal assistance, communication support or assistive software/hardware. Up to £1,200 per year.

opportunities.title: Researcher Collaborations Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: RSC members (Associate Member AMRSC, Member MRSC or Fellow FRSC) before submitting and for the duration of the grant; PhD students or researchers at any career stage, working in any sector or location.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers to establish and develop national, international, interdisciplinary and cross-sector collaborations and networks beyond their own institution, including research visits to collaborators' institutions and organising meetings/workshops. Up to £5000.
